provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: Panels A/B use the -0.25 s corrected shift (L32) while the repeated alignment block for C omits it (L97) although both derive from the same files -- inconsistent shifts between panels without explanation.

text('ADV 1') and legend at L57-58 are placed after the B data loads but before subplot(412), so they land on the first axes; panel labels 'ADV 1/2/3' differ from the AB script's 'ADV A/B' naming, and 'ADV 3' appears twice (L122 on axes 413, L133 on 414).

The C alignment block (L73-97) recomputes exactly what L8-32 already computed except the constant; num_shift_ind/exp_shift_ind never used; n=6 overwrites the size() result each time (L37, L53, L102, L118); vel padded to 6 columns though only columns 1-2 are plotted.
V-component comparison (L130) takes model vel(:,2), i.e. column 3 of VT_C_BM2_shi_tvd.txt; the column layout of the VT files is not documented in this script.

audit_member_text: L38-L39, L54-L55, L103-L104, and L119-L120 preallocate exactly six velocity columns but copy nn-1 columns without checking nn-1<=6; an input with more than seven columns causes an assignment-size failure.
L43, L62, L108, and L127 index measured velocity rows 1:25 for the baseline mean without checking that each measured file has at least 25 rows.

The plot calls pair t derived from the FSE file (L11 or L76) with vel derived from separate VT files (L39,L55,L104,L120), but no equality check ensures matching vector lengths before L46,L65,L111,L130.

The V panel plots vel(:,2) at L130 after loading VT_C at L116-L120; if VT_C contains only time plus one velocity component, column 2 remains the zero-filled column from L119, so the script silently plots zeros rather than rejecting the missing component.

The two peak searches use exact equality to max (L17,L25,L82,L90) and take the first occurrence via break (L20,L28,L85,L93); tied maxima therefore select the earliest peak without documenting whether that is intended.
